num_images.description: The number of images to generate.

use_turbo.description: Enable turbo mode for faster generation with high quality. When enabled, uses optimized settings (10 steps, CFG=1.2).

loras.description:
The LoRAs to use for the image generation. You can use up to 3 LoRAs
            and they will be merged together to generate the final image.

path.description: URL or the path to the LoRA weights.

scale.description:
The scale of the LoRA weight. This is used to scale the LoRA weight
            before merging it with the base model.

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

seed.description:
The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model
            will output the same image every time.

height.description: The height of the generated image.

width.description: The width of the generated image.

image_size.description: The size of the generated image. By default, we will use the provided image for determining the image_size.

negative_prompt.description: The negative prompt for the generation

image_url.description: The reference image to guide the generation.

acceleration.description: Acceleration level for image generation. Options: 'none', 'regular', 'high'. Higher acceleration increases speed. 'regular' balances speed and quality. 'high' is recommended for images without text.

guidance_scale.description:
The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want
            the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

prompt.description: The prompt to generate the image with
examples: Mount Fuji with purple japanese wisteria in the foreground, clear sky, peaceful spring day, soft natural light, landscape, painted with oil brush on a wood panel with abstract mixed colors

num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

strength.description: Denoising strength. 1.0 = fully remake; 0.0 = preserve original.

output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.
